Acme has had two NS-500 pricing exceptions:

| Exception | Max discount (off list price) | Valid for orders placed | Source |
|---|---|---|---|

| EXC-ACME-NS500-15 (replaces the 10% one) | **15%** | 2025-04-01 → 2028-03-31 | acme_pricing_exception.md, approved by David Morgan on 2025-03-20 |

On 2022-10-01, Acme would only have had whatever the general discount policy allowed, not an account-specific contract term. That policy requires VP Sales or CRO approval and recorded approval evidence, but I couldn't find a percentage cap in it for that period.

Sarah Chen's email of 2026-09-23 says Acme is asking for "15% off list, which is what we did for them last September". That refers to September 2025, which falls under the current 15% exception. It doesn't show any 2022 discount.
